_comment: v19 campaign grid — asymmetric barriers (K_TP > K_SL). Root-cause fix for v18 0/24 FAIL: symmetric 1:1 R:R had fee drag (~$196/yr) exactly cancelling gross edge. K_TP=2.0×ATR / K_SL=1.0×ATR → theoretical PF=3.26 at 62% WR. 18 combos × 2 windows = 36 runs.

_grid_rationale.k_tp: 1.5×ATR → modest 1.5:1 R:R (PF=2.45 at 62% WR). 2.0×ATR → 2:1 R:R (PF=3.26, theoretical optimum). 2.5×ATR → 2.5:1 R:R (PF=4.07, but TP harder to reach within label_period=6).
_grid_rationale.k_sl: 0.8×ATR → very tight stop (more SL hits, but each loss is smaller). 1.0×ATR → baseline tight stop. Both are tighter than v18's k_sl=2.0×ATR which let losers run for 14h avg.
_grid_rationale.ml_threshold: 0.60 = R8 winner (best PF at label_period=6). 0.65 = tighter precision, fewer trades. 0.70 = high-confidence only — tests whether quality beats quantity after R:R fix.
_grid_rationale.label_period_candles: Fixed at 6 (R8 grid winner — dominates over lp=12/24 at 1h TF). K_SL=0.8-1.0×ATR resolves more labels within 6h than v18's k_sl=2.0×ATR did.

_v18_root_cause.problem: Symmetric barriers k_tp=k_sl=K_MULT. At 62% WR and 1:1 R:R: gross edge exactly cancelled by ~$196/yr fee drag at 1700 trades/yr. PF range 0.83–0.996 across all 24 runs.
_v18_root_cause.secondary: Losers held avg 14h44m vs winners 7h10m — funding fees accumulate on drifting losing positions before SL fires at wide 2×ATR distance.
_v18_root_cause.fix: Asymmetric K_TP > K_SL: (a) cuts losers faster (smaller K_SL), (b) each win worth K_TP/K_SL × each loss, (c) break-even WR = 1/(1+K_TP/K_SL) = 33% at 2:1 R:R.
